definitions.explanation: Cold-blooded vertebrate animals that live both in water and on land, typically having an aquatic larval stage. The class Amphibia in biological classification.

examples.japanese: {蛙|かえる}は{両生類|りょうせいるい}です。
{両生類|りょうせいるい}は{水中|すいちゅう}と{陸上|りくじょう}の{両方|りょうほう}で{生活|せいかつ}できます。
examples.english: Amphibians can live both in water and on land.

examples.japanese: {両生類|りょうせいるい}は{環境|かんきょう}{変化|へんか}に{敏感|びんかん}です。
examples.english: Amphibians are sensitive to environmental changes.

notes:
{両生類|りょうせいるい} is a scientific classification term.

{両生|りょうせい} means "amphibious" (literally "both-living") and {類|るい} means "class."

Examples of amphibians:
- {蛙|かえる} (frog)
- {蝦蟇|がま} (toad)
- {山椒魚|さんしょううお} (salamander)
- イモリ (newt)

Amphibians go through metamorphosis from aquatic larvae (like tadpoles) to terrestrial adults.
